title: Web Requests Bot Detection Summary
description: Rich bot classification for aggregated web-request summary records. The bot name mirrors the standard ExperienceEvent Bot Detection field group, extended with ruleSource and ruleId to capture which detection signal produced a definitive match. Bot confidence is carried as an additive scoreSum plus a scoredRequests count so an average score (scoreSum / scoredRequests) re-aggregates correctly at any grain. Supersedes the coarse xdm:cdn.botType string from the CDN Requests Summary field group. These fields are system-generated and not user-editable.

xdm:botDetection.title: Bot Detection
xdm:botDetection.description: Information about bot generated traffic for the aggregated requests.

xdm:scoreSum.title: Bot Score Sum
xdm:scoreSum.description: Additive sum of the per-request bot probability scores (each between 0 and 1) across the aggregated requests. Not meaningful on its own; divide by scoredRequests to obtain an average bot score that re-aggregates correctly at any grain.

xdm:scoredRequests.title: Scored Request Count
xdm:scoredRequests.description: Number of aggregated requests that produced a bot score. Denominator for the average bot score (scoreSum / scoredRequests). Equals the total request count when every request is scored.

xdm:name.title: Name
xdm:name.description: Bot name of the matched rule (for example the IAB or customer rule name).

xdm:ruleSource.title: Rule Source
xdm:ruleSource.description: Which detection signal, if any, produced a definitive match. Suggested values only; new detectors may be added without a schema change.

xdm:ruleId.title: Rule Identifier
xdm:ruleId.description: Identifier of the matched customer rule. Empty unless ruleSource is 'customer'.
